body.objective: Expose minimal dependency and obstruction structure in the programme's large exact matrices through matroids, oriented matroids and hyperplane arrangements. Rank and nullspace answer whether a relation exists, but Conflux needs circuits, cocircuits and chamber adjacency to identify the smallest responsible rows, compare obstruction mechanisms across carriers and build a readable residual atlas. The first consumers are sf:program/work/bridge-component-incidence-classification, sf:program/work/bridge-all-m-incidence-moment-map-intersection and sf:program/work/bridge-residual-atlas-branch-manifest.
body.stop_condition: Provide representable matroids over exact fields from matrices and chain maps; bases, circuits, cocircuits, closures, flats, minors, duals, direct sums and connected components; oriented chirotopes/sign vectors over Q and real algebraic fields; hyperplane-arrangement cells and adjacency for bounded rank; symmetry-orbit compression; and proof witnesses for each circuit/cocircuit/minimal inconsistent subsystem. Support incremental updates after row/column mutations and parameter-stratum labels without assuming generic specialization. Demonstrate recovery of one minimal Taub/resonance obstruction subsystem, classify the all-m incidence/moment-map intersection by circuit orbits, and identify a common circuit minor across two separately presented Einstein/extra carriers. Cross-check small fixtures against Sage/OM or a separate determinant-enumeration rail. Export circuit and chamber objects to Conflux and the residual atlas.

notes: Priority B. This turns large obstruction ledgers into minimal, comparable mathematical mechanisms.
Compose with qmat/fmat, graph-hypergraph symmetry, polyhedral cones and semialgebraic rank stratification.
